content: Spine reading pipelines: segment spines (YOLO/SAM) -> crop/rotate -> OCR or VLM read -> fuzzy match against catalog DB (CLIP/BERT/Hungarian matching for noisy text). Commercial apps (Shelf Scan) do whole-shelf photo -> list. Failure modes: partial occlusion, partial text, mixed fonts; VLMs (GPT-4V, Gemini) read whole shelf photos directly with decent accuracy but need candidate verification against a DB.
